title: Component Shortage from Overseas Supplier
titleZh: 海外供應商零件短缺通知
paragraphs: Our main supplier has reported a shortage of a key component due to a delay in production. As a result, the next restock cycle will be smaller than usual, and some item may be out of stock for up to two week.

Purchasing has already requested a new quotation from a backup supplier to secure additional supply. Quality control will inspect the first sample shipment closely, since any defect could further delay the reorder process.

Store manager are asked to review current inventory and reorder critical item earlier than the normal schedule. Please avoid placing large order for non essential product until the shortage is resolved.
We will send an update once the supply situation improves. Thank you for your patience and cooperation.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of this memo?
options: A shortage of a component from a supplier
Requested a new quotation from a backup supplier

questions.stem: What is quality control expected to do?
options: Inspect the first sample batch closely

questions.stem: What can store manager most likely expect in the near future?
options: A need to reorder critical item earlier than usual
